clips.title: The story
paras: Explorers gather relics and records in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. The dwarven Explorers' League studies Azeroth's past here, seeking the origins of the dwarven race.

The Hall of Explorers fills a cavern in northeastern Ironforge. High Explorer Muninn Magellas directs scholars and field agents as they coordinate digs across distant lands. Relics, ancient titan machinery, and prehistoric bones return from those expeditions. At the hall's center, the Library holds historical lore, with displays open to visitors and other records kept under restriction.
